front.title: Homa: An RPC Transport Protocol for Datacenters

abstract.t: This document defines the Homa transport protocol. Homa provides applications with a reliable and efficient mechanism for delivering request and response messages for remote procedure calls (RPCs). It is intended for use within datacenters. Homa uses messages, receiver-issued grants, and packet priorities to support RPC workloads. Published evaluations report a reduction of more than 10x in tail latency for short messages relative to TCP for specific workloads and test conditions; this document does not claim a performance improvement for all datacenter environments.
